services.title: Auto repair
services.body: Vehicles are diagnosed and repaired at the actual fault before anything gets replaced.

reviews.author: Patricia Byers
reviews.text: Honest, dependable mechanics. Fast friendly service. Large waiting area, wifi, TV. Snacks and drinks are also available.

reviews.author: John Sheperd
reviews.text: They do good work. Priced very fairly i bring my work vehicle and personal one and I've never had a return trip. No upselling nonsense just a small business trying to get by and I'm happy to use their service.

reviews.author: Nicholas Guida
reviews.text: NC state inspection - Do not go unless you have a lot of time to waste. It took over an jour for an inspection

reviews.author: Jennifer Weaver
reviews.text: USED to be a great place. Been going there for 5 years. Took my brand new vehicle in for it's first inspection, was the 2nd person in the door after their lunch break, waited over an hour in the cold waiting room, paid a 4% fee for using my debit card, and to top it off my new car now smells like cigarette smoke (I don't smoke) and like someone needed a shower and my leather has some mystery substance on the steering wheel and console. Will never return again. Someone also came in and complained about "yesterday's service" while I was there so apparently the place is going downhill.

reviews.author: Amy Brown
reviews.text: The best place in town! Not only do they give remarkable service to the vehicles that they service but also to their customers. They continually keep you updated, share the estimated cost, and care for the comfort of the customer while they wait. Bishop Tire and Auto Service has been a God send to our family and our elderly family members on more than one occasion.

reviews.author: Bryan Ritter
reviews.text: We have taken several cars there for inspections and other work with zero issues at all. Prices for service were much better than other places and the staff has been friendly each time. Will continue to use them for any needs and have no problem sending my wife alone to have vehicles taken care of. We pass by several other shops in the area to go to them and have no reason to go anywhere else.

reviews.author: Wes B
reviews.text: This was my first of many to come trips to Bishop Tire and Auto. They offer fast, friendly and honest service at an affordable price. Unlike dealerships and franchise repair places, they will only fix what you need fixed…rather than try to replace your entire vehicle one part at a time. It’s so nice to support a local business with honest professionals.

reviews.author: Parks Durham
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about ths this shop.. This is a family owned business and I love to patronize small businesses whenever I can.. They always do an amazing job on my vehicle. They never over promise but always over deliver. What I like about the shop is their honesty if you're looking for an honest there shop then this is the place for you. They are also reasonably priced and they have a very quick turnaround. If you are in the Mount Holly Stanley Lincolnton area and are looking for a great shop I can definitely recommend the shop hands down

reviews.author: Brady Davis
reviews.text: Good customer service and good place to get your vehicle done. They good price on every thing there. Thank you very much for helping us with our church van and food Truck.

reviews.author: Toni Coes
reviews.text: Love Bishop Tire and Auto. They get you in and out. Very professional and the costs are very reasonable. They are the only people I will allow to work on my car. I have 3 cars and they taken excellent care of them all. Missed them when the lockdown occurred. They are very a necessary service. All of their employees are top rated and very professional.

reviews.author: Mr. Reviewer
reviews.text: This great little independent repair shop is owned by Three Brothers, their work is of high quality and very reasonably priced. I take all three of my vehicles from South Charlotte to this location when I need brake repair, alignment and tune-ups. I find that their pricing is very competitive compared to the big box shops such as Firestone, Precision Tune, Meineke and Midas, they stand behind the work they perform and warranty most repairs. I had a single axle brake job with new rotors installed at Mr. Tire... they charged me over $500... I had the front axle on the same vehicle done here at Bishop and it was only two-thirds the price for the same components- performance ceramic brake shoes and upgraded rotors. My recommendation is= if you like high quality work at a very reasonable price point this is the shop that I recommend, they work on All Foreign & Domestic vehicles.

reviews.author: Johnny Pocketts
reviews.text: There's never been an issue arise from utizling the services of this establishment. I have taken my vehicles to Bishop many times and each time I have left with satisfaction and a smile. There is no one in the area I would trust with the care, concern and craftsmanship of my car(s).

reviews.author: Pamela Kelly
reviews.text: Big shout out to Bishops Tire and Auto Service for going above and beyond in helping me out today. They squeezed me in, found the issue and got it resolved in one day. They even took me home and picked me up when it was completed so I didn't have to call an Uber. We'll definitely use them again the next time we need something done. Highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Sporadic Travels
reviews.text: Got a tune up on my truck. Service was good. I normally go to Quinn’s, but they were full up for the week and I needed service the day I went. Glad I did and I’ll always use them as a reliable alternate.

reviews.author: CandM Services
reviews.text: Got a new set of Tires for my Ram, they look and feel great! I be happier everyone was super helpful & they got it done quick ! 10/10 will be back

reviews.author: Eva Adrien (The Duck)
reviews.text: I drove thru the state and my car tires is low. I have newborn baby in backseat and I’m on way my home in Florida and I saw lot people in waiting room to pick their car and I was worried that they may made me wait too but nope they do my car tire air quick and let me get back on road to home in Florida. I’m impressive their fast work and very friendly! I will recommend this place

reviews.author: Quinn Goins
reviews.text: These guys are highly efficient, and do great work. If you need tires, oil change, diagnostic, come see these guys and they will have you rolling without a care.

reviews.author: Kimberly Berry
reviews.text: Service is always great! We have been going to them since we moved to Mt Holly. They are very honest and trustworthy. I recommend 100%

reviews.author: Sha Baksa
reviews.text: Got a few things done to myy older Volvo and other vehicles, for the most part I trust their analysis. I trusty them to a degree to get the job done, more so than other mechanic establishments. Prices are fairly reasonable, and staff is friendly and courteous.

reviews.author: Sean Deegan
reviews.text: These guys have become my go to place if I need work done on my vehicles. Always fast friendly service. It's nice to find an auto service place that isn't always trying to rip you off. They have my business for sure.

reviews.author: Sean C
reviews.text: They treat people like they'd want to be treated. I drive an older car. It is going to have its share of problems. They told me what the issues were and were up front about what needed fixing to make it road worthy and what could wait so I could spread out the repair expense. Then when my wife was going to be late picking me up at closing time they gave me a ride home to boot. Good honest people who deserve the solid reputation they have in the community.

reviews.author: kris hoke
reviews.text: Very friendly, honest and good prices. I like that I can buy my own parts at a cheaper price and bring them in and just pay labor if I want to. Not alot of garages will allow that.

reviews.author: Marty Hartsell
reviews.text: I made an appt and asked for an alignment. When I explained what the car was doing, the person at the desk suggested balancing the tires, which was much cheaper. I appreciate them recommending the cheaper fix. And they were right, the car is now back driving well since the tires were balanced.

reviews.author: Toni Coes
reviews.text: I have lived in Stanley NC for 18 years and I have had 3 cars Bishop Tire & Auto have taken care of all of my vehicles. Simply they care for all of their customers, I have never had to wait for service, come in check your vehicle out give suggestions and they do absolutely a fantastic job. An there cost are much lower than the dealership and the other repair places in Gastonia. If you live in Gaston county come and check Bishop Tire and Auto out you won't be sorry.

reviews.author: Mary Whiteside
reviews.text: Great place. Great service. Friendly and good prices. I highly recommend. I went in for tires and inspection and it only took 30 minutes. All the employees are excellent.

reviews.author: Alice Houser
reviews.text: We have been using them forever! They have serviced and repaired our vehicles timely and at a reasonable price. Always courteous and friendly.

reviews.author: David Shields
reviews.text: 2 new tires, oil changed and inspection done in 40 mins. The staff was very professional and very well mannered. I will be coming back. Prices are reasonable also.

reviews.author: David Kleinert
reviews.text: THIS PLACE IS A JOKE!! Took my wives car to have front end work done. Quoted HIGHLY inflated price. Tried to charge 3x the amount of the parts.I know this because I priced the parts myself at NAPA. Had the same EXACT work done couple miles up the road for a 3rd of the price.Unless your broken down in their parking lot .DO NOT GO HERE for any repairs. Even then I would pay a towing fee to take to another shop. It would be MUCH cheaper.I would give less then 1 star if possible.

reviews.author: Scott Jolley
reviews.text: I have been there several times now. After moving from Clt to Stanley NC. They have always been very friendly and done exactly what they said they was going to do. I’m very happy with the service I have received from them.

reviews.author: mike dillon
reviews.text: Great group of guys that make you feel at home while they service your vehicle.Or you can drop it off and pick it up later. Very good service. Come over and see them for your car's needs.

reviews.author: Cindy Tilley
reviews.text: The best place hands down. We won’t take our vehicles anywhere else. Very honest. And much less $ than other places.

reviews.author: Ryan Brown
reviews.text: They took great care of me after a dealership in Gastonia botched the repairs of my Toyota Highlander. I will not be taking either of my Toyotas to that dealership in Gastonia for any more repairs or maintenance. These men have earned my trust. From now on, the Bishop brothers are my first choice!

reviews.author: t dibart
reviews.text: Bishop Tire provides excellent service, are professional, knowledgeable and really nice guys! Prices are competitive and all is explained. Flexable appt schedule, ty!

reviews.author: beau fortner
reviews.text: Total waste of time and money, took my 97 Tahoe there for simple inspection, they charged me $33.75 and failed the vehicle for the 22 year old factory tint, claiming is was 27% and took dark... The next place I took it to informed me it was actually 35% and that it was perfectly fine.

reviews.author: William Haller
reviews.text: The gas Bishop Tire and Auto are awesome I've been there several times various things to be fixed on my vehicle it was always done right the first time at a reasonable price and on time!!

reviews.author: Cathy Penson
reviews.text: Wonderful people. Stayed over and fixed my tire that blew out on me. Highly highly reccomend them. Would not go anywhere else!!!!

reviews.author: Hannah Laiti
reviews.text: Great, honest service. So friendly and reasonably priced. I'm so happy to have found a mechanic I trust

reviews.author: Alex Lawrence
reviews.text: Bishop Tire offers great service and has always been very reasonably priced. I would recommend them to anyone needing tires or automotive repair.

reviews.author: C Cass
reviews.text: The guys at Bishop are always super helpful. They will take appointments and their work is always top notch.

reviews.author: jefferson kendrick
reviews.text: Billy and Luther Bishop are great, AC, tires, suspension, brakes, they always get it done reasonably, and quickly. Nicest people I know!

reviews.author: Freda Good
reviews.text: Bishop tire has always given me great service at reasonable prices. They go the extra mile on customer satisfaction.

reviews.author: Sherry Tolentino
reviews.text: Would not go anywhere else for my car service. Reliable service and prices. Will not ever suggest repairs that are not necessary

reviews.author: Stress Free Home Care
reviews.text: They’ve always taken care of our needs are very informative and professional. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Johnny Moore
reviews.text: I feel they overcharge. They supposedly fixed something and it broke again shortly afterwards. They charged me labor. Very disappointed.

reviews.author: david whiteside
reviews.text: Bishop puts the service back in auto service. They are my go to when I am not able to do the work myself. Always fair.

reviews.author: Daphne Green
reviews.text: I have gone to Bishop Tire & Auto on three different occasions and they are the nicest people and so professional!

reviews.author: Vj Beer
reviews.text: Came in for an inspection and decided to go ahead and have the oil changed. Very fast , friendly and affordable

reviews.author: Rick Cardenas
reviews.text: I love coming here. Luther and Bill are awesome. They always take care of me and give me good pricing for all repairs. I recently took my camper there after having a blowout on I-26 in SC. I was able to drop my camper off and have the tires upgraded there on the property. They take good care of my Ram 3500 dually. While I know there are some things on it they may not be able to do, they take care of the rest. I always love to support a local small business and they help me out no matter what. I can even drop off my vehicle and pick it back up. They also are great for scheduling services in advance so you can plan ahead.
